extension.summary: Lean enhancements for Estuary MOD V2
extension.description: A small, non-destructive set of enhancements for skin.estuary.modv2 (Estuary MOD V2), built fresh against the Omega release. Reorders the gear Settings menu so Skin Settings sits above Media sources, and adds a dedicated "Tony.7.Bones MOD V2+" Skin Settings category that is home to our tweaks. Each tweak is individually toggleable and defaults to the stock look: the System Info overlay, stock-white weather icons (vs MOD V2 colored), the thin stock clock (vs MOD V2 bold), and the crisp white navigation wordmark (vs the MOD V2 original). The category also carries in-tab Apply and Restore buttons. Run after installing or updating skin.estuary.modv2. Apply and Restore are both available — original files are backed up once and never overwritten, and Restore reverts every change cleanly.
extension.news: Tony.7.Bones MOD V2+ tab now lets you toggle each tweak (weather icons, clock, nav logo) between stock and MOD V2 style, plus Apply/Restore buttons in the tab. Defaults to the stock look.
